\(C = S\,N(d_1) - K e^{-rT} N(d_2)\),

where  

\(d_1 = \frac{\ln(S/K) + (r + \frac{1}{2}\sigma^2)T}{\sigma\sqrt{T}}\)

\(\sigma\sqrt{T} = 0.20 \times 1 = 0.20\).  
Thus \(d_1 = \frac{0 + 0.07}{0.20} = 0.35\).

2. Compute \(d_2\):  
\(d_2 = 0.35 - 0.20 = 0.15\).

\(N(d_1) \approx 0.6368\) and \(N(d_2) \approx 0.5596\).

4. Calculate the call price:  
\(C = 100 \times 0.6368 - 100 \times e^{-0.05 \times 1} \times 0.5596\)  
\(= 63.68 - 100 \times 0.9512 \times 0.5596\)  
\(= 63.68 - 53.18\)
